# Files-changed fixtures

Trimmed from GitHub's public Files changed page on 2026-11-24. The classic
renderer was fetched signed out; the React renderer was saved from signed-in
Chrome. Repository identity, file paths and content were replaced with synthetic
examples. Only structural attributes needed by the adapter remain significant.

The React fixture preserves the progressive list's outer diff entry, region,
labelled heading and leaf tree row. The classic fixture preserves the diff
wrapper, header path and tree anchor. Synthetic source and folder rows exercise
nonmatching paths and directory safety.
